description.value:
Frequency once per day

Your Afflicted lose the minion trait for the duration: they roll their own initiative and act on standing orders you set without being Commanded. You may maintain up to your cap +2 while it lasts.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Command all/multiple Afflicted with one action" has no rule-element automation anywhere in pf2e-source: grep -rli "command" pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/ and find pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element -iname "*command*" both return zero hits. Minion "Command" in real pf2e is a manually GM-tracked action with no rule-element automation of any kind. Afflicted is this class's minion subsystem: a raise-cap, a collapse timer, and (at level 18) a shared cross-actor Resonance pool. pf2e's schema has no generic "max controlled minions" field, no "minion lifespan" field, and no mechanism for one actor's rule element to modify a different actor's stats on an ongoing basis. Removing the minion trait from a different creature and granting it autonomous behavior has no cross-actor mechanism; ItemAlteration's traits property (add/remove/subtract) only touches items (weapons/armor), never a creature's own trait list, and never across actors regardless.
